_comment: Qwen Image 2.1 text encoder (text-to-image and image edit). `prompt` is usually wired through a Preview as Text and an If/Else Switch that picks between the raw prompt and a Generate Text enhancer's rewrite; recognition follows all of it (see logic.json / text_generate.json), so the one Prompt box writes both. Reference images are an autogrow input numbered from 1 (images.image_1 … image_16), hence `start: 1`. The enhancer sees the same pictures through a Batch Images node numbered from 0 — the `mirrors` entry keeps that node wired to the same files.

resolution.label: Reference size (px; 0 keeps each image's own size)
